summary: Gulaab Gang is a 2014 Indian Hindi-language action drama film about the struggle of women in India. Directed by Soumik Sen and produced by Anubhav Sinha, it stars Madhuri Dixit and Juhi Chawla and was released on 7 March 2014. Critics gave it positive-to-mixed reviews, praising Chawla's performance, while the makers declared it a flop on its opening day.
one_line: Gulaab Gang is a 2014 Hindi action drama film about women's struggle in India, starring Madhuri Dixit and Juhi Chawla.
key_facts: Gulaab Gang is a 2014 Indian Hindi-language action drama film.

Gulaab Gang was produced by Anubhav Sinha.

Gulaab Gang was released on 7 March 2014.
Upon its release, Gulaab Gang received positive-to-mixed reviews from critics.
Critics raved about Juhi Chawla's performance in Gulaab Gang, calling it the best performance of the year.
The makers of Gulaab Gang declared the film a flop on its opening day itself.
